description:
Research manuscript edition prepared in the aomart class. F2 and F3-prime remain open. The two exceptional directions have not been represented by constructed algebraic cycles.

This is a typesetting and bounded-results research revision, not journal acceptance or a claim that all requested open conjectures have been solved. No new human mathematical review is asserted. The exact changes and AI-assisted preparation are recorded with the files. The existing paper, figures and verification sources are retained in this repository archive.
